phase_boundary: After the first locked Stage 5 collection pass stopped at 770/780 row outputs; before the Stage 5 audit or any held-out accuracy evaluation.

trigger.observation: Both neutral checks and all three exact-control perspectives exhausted the original three attempts. All 15 retained responses entered repetitive generations and ended before closing a valid JSON object.

fail_closed_resolution.rule: If and only if a predeclared case key has no complete analysis bundle because a structured-output contract is exhausted, do not call the selector and copy the pre-existing memory endpoint for both workflow variants.
fail_closed_resolution.transport_errors: Never resolved by this rule; they remain fatal and must be replayed idempotently.
fail_closed_resolution.malformed_content: Never parsed, repaired, or used as a verdict.
fail_closed_resolution.provenance: Every failed attempt cache key is embedded in the immutable fail-closed output and checked against the same victim model.

evaluation_requirements: The four affected rows remain in primary scoring and receive the same prediction as the model-only endpoint.
The amendment-2 sensitivity already excludes every Qwen claim-264 row and therefore also excludes all outputs resolved here.
All confirmation gates must still be reported in both the primary and exclusion-sensitivity scopes.
prohibited_changes: Do not extract the apparent verdict or any proposition from a truncated response.
Do not add semantic retries or change prompts, decoding, gates, models, attacks, or claim scope.
Do not apply this rule to a timeout, provider error, or undeclared case key.
Do not drop the affected rows.
rationale: Memory fallback is the workflow's frozen safe default and cannot outperform model-only on these rows. Applying it symmetrically to the proposed workflow and its exact-call control is conservative, keeps the sample complete, and avoids selecting a favorable label from malformed text.
